current_activity: command post at Siegburg as the armored division drives along the Rhine to turn behind the Ruhr defenders
notes: Event date: 12 April 1945 (CMH ETO-OB command-post list of the 13th Armored Division: Siegburg on 12 Apr 45; Last Offensive ch. 16 p. 366-367: committed on 10 April to pass through troops of the 97th Division, the 13th Armored Division, under Maj. Gen. John B. Wogan, was to drive along the Rhine to a point east of Cologne and then turn northeast to get in behind the Germans fighting against the 8th, 78th and 86th Divisions). Event definition: the division is on the Sieg two days after it was committed; the row is a position of the division command post, not a record of a fight. Relationship: XVIII Airborne Corps unspecified_subordination (from 10 Apr 45 to 20 Apr 45, CMH table); First Army attached (from 10 Apr 45 to 20 Apr 45, CMH table); Third Army assigned (from 8 Apr 45, CMH table); 12th Army Group assigned (from 18 Jan 45, CMH table). The table entries start on the first row of the unbroken run (convention V-013). The CMH table has a single corps column and does not say assigned or attached for a corps. Location: Siegburg (CMH ETO-OB command-post list, R571 p. 535: listed 12 April 1945); the town centre stands for the command post. Coordinates: Wikipedia (en): Siegburg. Event support: moderate (one Green Book passage and the CMH table and command-post list). Location support: moderate (command post listed on the date).

current_activity: command post at Tann, near the Inn, the day the XX Corps bridges the Inn at three places
notes: Event date: 2 May 1945 (CMH ETO-OB command-post list of the 13th Armored Division: Tann on 2 May 45; Last Offensive ch. 18 p. 437 and ch. 19 p. 466: the 13th Armored Division crossed the Isar near Landau on 29 April and reached the Inn around Braunau on 1 May, the first of Patton's troops to reach the Austrian frontier in strength; on 2 May XX Corps divisions bridged the Inn at three places and captured Braunau and Passau). Event definition: the division command post is in Lower Bavaria, about 20 km from the Inn, the day after the division reached the river. Relationship: XX Corps unspecified_subordination (from 22 Apr 45, CMH table); Third Army assigned (from 8 Apr 45, CMH table); 12th Army Group assigned (from 18 Jan 45, CMH table). The table entries start on the first row of the unbroken run (convention V-013). The CMH table has a single corps column and does not say assigned or attached for a corps. Location: Tann (CMH ETO-OB command-post list, R571 p. 535: listed 2 May 1945); the town centre stands for the command post. Coordinates: Wikipedia (en): Tann, Bavaria. Event support: moderate (one Green Book chapter, two pages, the CMH table and the CMH Combat Chronicle). Location support: moderate (command post listed on the date). Review (27 October 2026, found while checking this row against a source not used to write it): the CMH Combat Chronicle of the division (R582) says the division "smashed into Braunau, Austria, 2 May, and the command post was set up in the house where Hitler was born"; the command-post list has Tann on 2 May 45 and no entry for Braunau. The two are not reconciled here: the row follows the command-post list (Tann), and the Chronicle may describe a forward command post or a later day.
